title: Genesis Action Forge R0
purpose: Let a player type an explicit action in natural language, derive a deterministic action seed from canonical world causes plus that text, compile it into a bounded intent IR, validate it, and execute only allowlisted local World Shell actions.

r0_semantics.movement: Discrete bounded movement is compiled from explicit direction/step language or deterministically chosen from the action seed for explore/wander language.
r0_semantics.action_anchor: Free-form create/build/place language may create a visible PLAYER_MARK-compatible action anchor carrying a sanitized concept and recipe provenance. R0 does not claim arbitrary nouns already have bespoke mesh/material generators.
r0_semantics.presentation: Mirror, 2D/3D and camera commands call existing presentation controls and never become Chronicle events.

legacy_lineage.name: JANUS_GENESIS_TEXT_ACTION_LOOP
legacy_lineage.adopted: player writes an action and the world responds while persistent world state survives between turns
legacy_lineage.reinterpretation: free text is compiled to bounded intent IR instead of directly granting model output world authority

legacy_lineage.name: HYPNOS_VOICE_OF_CREATOR
legacy_lineage.adopted: explicit typed player input can redirect generation
legacy_lineage.reinterpretation: explicit input only; no creator hierarchy and no hidden human-state inference

legacy_lineage.name: TD_ACTION_VOCABULARY
legacy_lineage.adopted: small semantic action language underneath richer natural-language commands
legacy_lineage.reinterpretation: general Genesis world intents rather than tower-defense-only actions
